title: L’Oréal Paris and Ariana Greenblatt spotlight street harassment in new campaign
summary: As part of the United Nations’ (UN) 16 Days of Activism Against Gender-Based Violence, L’Oréal Paris and actress Ariana Greenblatt will spotlight the beauty brand’s Stand Up Against Street Harassment programme

extraction.key_fact: 로레알 파리가 배우 아리아나 그린블랫과 함께 거리 괴롭힘 반대 프로그램을 알리는 캠페인을 펼친다.
